'''Sector 17''' was a stretch of land in [[Ardan resistance|rebel]] territory that was scanned by [[Jerrod Lourdas]] over [[Sector 7]]. Jerrod was then scolded by his [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Superiors]] for this.

==History==
[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Var Narek]] placed a [[Hyperspace transponder]] on a rock in Sector 17 because he believed that it was too boring for anyone to notice the transponder.<ref name="Onslaught at Arda I" />
